verdict.rationale: HRIS/payroll sync is a fair question for a cap table and equity management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows only cap table migration from other providers (Pulley, Carta), spreadsheet import, and manual share issuance to employees. None of these is an automated integration with Gusto, Rippling, or any other HRIS/payroll system that syncs new hires and terminations into equity records.
